```json
[
  {"input": "\"b\"\n\"a\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"a\"\n\"a\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"aa\"\n\"a\"", "output": "3"},
  {"input": "\"abcabc\"\n\"a\"", "output": "3"},
  {"input": "\"xyz\"\n\"q\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"banana\"\n\"a\"", "output": "6"},
  {"input": "\"abcdefghij\"\n\"j\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"aaaa\"\n\"a\"", "output": "10"},
  {"input": "\"cabcbc\"\n\"c\"", "output": "6"},
  {"input": "\"abababab\"\n\"b\"", "output": "10"}
]
```

Each expected output is k(k+1)/2, where k is the number of positions in `s` holding `c`. For example, "banana" with "a" has k = 3 (positions 1, 3, 5), giving 6.

```json
[
  {"input": "\"abc\"\n\"a\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"abc\"\n\"d\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"a\"\n\"a\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"aaaa\"\n\"a\"", "output": "10"},
  {"input": "\"banana\"\n\"a\"", "output": "6"},
  {"input": "\"hello\"\n\"l\"", "output": "3"},
  {"input": "\"xyzxyzx\"\n\"x\"", "output": "6"},
  {"input": "\"abcabcabc\"\n\"b\"", "output": "6"},
  {"input": "\"qwertyuiop\"\n\"q\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"cacbcdc\"\n\"c\"", "output": "10"}
]
```

Each expected output is k(k+1)/2, where k is the number of occurrences of c in s. Substrings that start and end at the same occurrence count, and every pair of occurrences (including a pair with itself) gives one valid substring.
